item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows square P of side 2 cm and square Q of side 4 cm. The side length is multiplied by 2 from P to Q.

Which statement about the area is correct?

options.A: The area of Q is 4 times the area of P, because area scales with the square of the side factor.
options.B: The area of Q is 2 times the area of P, matching the side factor.
options.C: The perimeter becomes 4 times as large, and that same factor rule applies to area.
options.D: The area stays the same because both figures are still squares.
